generate_shape_scenes: generate Minecraft shape scenes with configurable dimensions and save segmentation data as pickle
convert_json_to_segdata: convert a JSON scene with blocks and instance segmentation tags into numpy segmentation arrays
build_shape_scene: build a Minecraft shape scene using build_shape_scene with configurable scene size and shape count
create_segdata_arrays: create segmentation data arrays from JSON block locations and instance segmentation tags
pickle_scene_data: generate multiple shape scenes and pickle the segmentation data to a file path
